candidate_values.origin: project convention within the paper's stated range; a uniform 0.25 grid is not claimed to be the paper's unspecified complete grid

model_extension_note: Appendix G reports a beta search universe through 40.0/q and a selected default list ending at 25.0/q. This project adds 40.0 to that selected list and extends the reported universe with 50.0 for baseline model-block coverage and 100.0 for an observed QA-LDLQ outlier. These extensions are project protocol choices, not paper defaults.
